title: Coin Collecter Game
tagline: A game where you control  😃  to try to collect all coins to win the game
description:
A game where you collect all coins 
 
How it works:
- User can control  😃  and move around
- User can collect coin to earn points
- There are walls and rock to block the 😃 from passing through

Future Feature:
- Add scores to keep track of the coins collected
- Add more map and levels
- Improve the UI of the game
how_its_made: I built the game using React and Phaser.  It was my first time building a game using Phaser.  I learned basic feature such as adding player to move around and placing coins, walls, and rocks in the game.  I had trouble working with MUD and was unable to connect the game to the contract.
